sourceFile: 17. TIU C11-20  Report checking Frame+vp separate lot using Frame clean Ethanol date 22.12.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test evidence but misgroups the changed factor and lacks a clear normal-lot baseline comparison.
issues: Changed factor mixes lot, side, shift, time, and totals as one condition.
Baseline normal lot is referenced but not supported by cited result rows.
TIU C11-20R/L and shifts should likely be subgroup keys, not primary changes.
Outcome totals and time rows may be double-counted as independent results.
Decision row is cited in context but no conclusion is captured.
requiredUserQuestions: Which rows contain the normal-lot baseline results?
Are TIU C11-20R and TIU C11-20L sides or separate test lots?
correctionPlan: Set primary change to Frame clean Ethanol/dry 12h test versus normal lot if supported.
Move side, shift, time, and total labels into subgroup keys.
Separate raw time rows from subtotal/total rows to avoid duplicate comparisons.
Add baseline outcome rows or mark baseline data unavailable.
Capture any decision/conclusion from the decision section if present.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient for final evidence until baseline and grouping citations are corrected.
